facility.name: The Goddard School
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3740 WILLIAMS DR, GEORGETOWN, TX, 78628

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver was missing 15 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: One caregiver was observed closing the door to the playground while two children were outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Two caregivers sprayed children with water as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: After becoming aware of an incident that may have placed children at risk, the operation did not notify parents until 8 days later.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver observed concerning behaviors by another caregiver and failed to report those concerns to administration.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: After an incident occurred, the operation did not share and receive parent signature on an incident report within 48 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: Observed a caregiver without proof of education in a caregiver role. The operation was advised to put in a waiver for the caregiver. The caregiver will not be in a caregiver role until education or a waiver is completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was found that a child was left in a classroom without adult supervision. The child was in the restroom when the teacher left with the other children to go to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: A child was injured while in care and the parent was not notified at pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children did not have a health statement from a physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child was missing two immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infants did not have monthly feeding instructions reviewed by parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training: The director was missing 14 hours of annual training for the previous training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Seven teachers did not have a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver was missing 6 hours of annual training hours for the previous training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Two caregivers did not have completed pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One caregiver did not have current CPR training that adheres to the guidelines for CPR for a layperson established by the American Heart Association, and consist of a curriculum that incudes use of a CPR manikin and both written and hands-on skill-based instruction, practice, and testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operation did not have proof that a gas inspection had been completed within the last two years. The last gas inspection report that could be located at the operation was 3/18/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Observed the last fire inspection was completed 8/2022 and it has not been completed since.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Observed an infant sleeping in a bouncy seat. This was corrected when Licensing asked for the child to removed from the device and placed in a crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: An infant was observed to be sleeping in the crib wearing a swaddle. This was corrected when the swaddle was removed from the infant. The infants hands/arms were not free and was confined inside the swaddle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: It was found during an investigation that a caregiver used prohibited punishments on children in care by tightly grabbing their arm and holding a child's arm behind their back.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver in one classroom stated that they had 7 children in care. When licensing stated that there were 8 children, the caregiver again said that they had 7 children and then said that they just had a child come in and they do have 8 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During an investigation it was found that a child was able to get ahold of a vape that had fallen out of a caregiver's pocket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: It was found that parents were asked not to enter the building until March 2022. The Covid emergency orders expired in April 2021, which then allowed full access to the building for parents without denial from the operation staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: Observed a baby lounger in the infant classroom with an infant using the equipment. This was corrected when the lounger was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: A gas leak test had not been completed since 10/18/2019. The gas leak test is required every 2 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: A health inspection was not able to be provided for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward: A caregiver used food as a reward for good behavior.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Food not a reward (26 TAC §746.3301(h))
